items.text: Sandbag barricades now stack up to 20 in inventory and appear in loot stacks of 4, increasing availability.
Cow panels now display genetics information.
Animals must be tamed before you can lead or milk them; untamed animals no longer show lead or milk options.
Overcrowding thresholds increased (crowded from 4 to 5, severe from 6 to 9) and packing radius reduced to 2.5 m, easing animal clustering issues.
New client‑side trigger pushes players off livestock, preventing standing on them.
Livestock vendor sales reworked: uses normalized value as currency, randomizes offers, adds penalties for wild/purchased animals, includes new items like pistol ammo and a rare red keycard.
Ammo amounts for weapons have been doubled, providing more firepower per reload.
Optional mission objectives can now be omitted, allowing the Underwater Labs mission to be completed even if a lab lacks a boombox.
Jellyfish populations now spawn correctly, fixing a bug where they were absent.
Leads no longer break easily, reducing accidental rope failures. Sheep now display their genetic information in the UI.
Livestock animals now have client‑side colliders that block player movement, preventing players from walking through them.
Sheep display their gene information in the UI; other animals do not.
Fixed a null‑reference crash that could occur when player snapshots arrive out of order during connection, improving stability.
Fixed a null‑reference crash when initializing a parented player, preventing connection issues.
Additional windows in Harbor 2 were boarded up, closing unintended sightlines into the loot room.
Pressing the inventory button now directly opens the dedicated crafting screen, streamlining crafting access.
Fixed jungle animals (crocs, tiger panther, wolves) failing to spawn due to an overly broad proximity check.
Doubled wild cow and sheep population density (1 → 2 per km²).
Reduced grazing time share for cows and sheep from 0.4 to 0.3, lowering their daily food requirement.
Cows and sheep now gain double fullness when eating from a trough.
Fixed incorrect animal reference when selling wool, ensuring proper transaction handling.
Fixed milk‑skimming UI: correct item notices, proper stacking, added skim option above drink to avoid misclicks, and played a skim effect.
Fixed Creamy Pure Cooling Tea incorrectly raising max temperature.
Frogs now animate correctly on spawn/despawn and jellyfish populate as intended.
Livestock block player movement, preventing walking through them.
Sheep UI now displays genetic information.
Jungle animals now spawn correctly after fixing a distance check.
Wild cows and sheep populations have doubled, they consume less daily food, and gain double fullness when feeding from troughs.
Selling wool no longer triggers a reference error.
Leads are now more durable and no longer break easily.
Added a dedicated crafting screen action; holding the inventory button opens the crafting screen directly.
Milk skimming UI fixed: proper item notices, skim option, milk effect, and correct icons for new items.
Harbor 2 windows boarded up, closing an unintended view into the loot room.
Crashes caused by out-of-order network snapshots when players connect have been resolved.
Creamy Pure Cooling Tea no longer raises your maximum temperature incorrectly.

2026-09-29.summary:
### Animals & Livestock

- Livestock block player movement, preventing walking through them.
- Sheep UI now displays genetic information.
- Jungle animals now spawn correctly after fixing a distance check.
- Wild cows and sheep populations have doubled, they consume less daily food, and gain double fullness when feeding from troughs.
- Selling wool no longer triggers a reference error.

### Items & Crafting
- Leads are now more durable and no longer break easily.
- Added a dedicated crafting screen action; holding the inventory button opens the crafting screen directly.
- Milk skimming UI fixed: proper item notices, skim option, milk effect, and correct icons for new items.

### World & Map Changes
- Harbor 2 windows boarded up, closing an unintended view into the loot room.

### Connectivity & Stability
- Crashes caused by out-of-order network snapshots when players connect have been resolved.

### Consumables
- Creamy Pure Cooling Tea no longer raises your maximum temperature incorrectly.

items.text: Livestock purchases now correctly credit the buying player and use a server‑side RPC, fixing desync and ensuring proper ownership.

Vendor inventory cleaned up: duplicate Custom SMG removed and replaced with a Thompson; items filtered by game mode (no guns in Primitive); turret offers only on high‑quality sales; new high‑end sale options added (BP fragments, Thompson, Custom SMG, Python, HC Revolver); wool now makes up ~75% of livestock sales, removing guns from livestock sales.
Break‑in option disabled on a teammate’s own apartment room, preventing accidental intrusions.
Fixed issue where teammates could not exit rooms after a server restart.
Livestock now match player speed when led, eliminating lead breaks and long waits.
Critter health reduced (frogs 60 HP, rabbits 100 HP) and frog size increased 20% for better balance and visibility.
Critters now flee when damaged while startled, and bull AI rotation fixed when target is lost, improving animal combat behavior.

Loot room exploits patched across maps: Radtown crate repositioned, Trainyard crate and surrounding railings sealed, Harbor 1 gaps boarded up, and all Harbor 2 windows sealed to stop cheating via shooting into loot rooms.
Null‑reference crash on destroyed elevator floors during saves fixed, improving overall stability.
Mortar desynchronization resolved for reconnecting players and those entering network range, ensuring consistent combat.
Open fence gates added to the ranch and large barn, providing easier access to the vendor area.
Water sources can now be transferred between rooms via sinks without errors.
Crabs now respect step height, avoid walls, and have corrected leg speeds; jellyfish water checks are optimized, improving swarm behavior.
Floating animal glitches are resolved, and idle animal performance is smoother.
Frogs no longer perform an excessively long first jump and will not get stuck in dead animations.
Biofuel generators are silent while idle, eliminating background noise.

2026-09-28.summary:

- Vendor inventory cleaned up: duplicate Custom SMG removed and replaced with a Thompson; items filtered by game mode (no guns in Primitive); turret offers only on high‑quality sales; new high‑end sale options added (BP fragments, Thompson, Custom SMG, Python, HC Revolver); wool now makes up ~75% of livestock sales, removing guns from livestock sales.

### Teammate Interaction
- Break‑in option disabled on a teammate’s own apartment room, preventing accidental intrusions.
- Fixed issue where teammates could not exit rooms after a server restart.

### Animal & Wildlife
- Livestock now match player speed when led, eliminating lead breaks and long waits.
- Critter health reduced (frogs 60 HP, rabbits 100 HP) and frog size increased 20% for better balance and visibility.
- Critters now flee when damaged while startled, and bull AI rotation fixed when target is lost, improving animal combat behavior.

### Map & Loot Anti‑Cheat
- Loot room exploits patched across maps: Radtown crate repositioned, Trainyard crate and surrounding railings sealed, Harbor 1 gaps boarded up, and all Harbor 2 windows sealed to stop cheating via shooting into loot rooms.

### Stability & Networking
- Null‑reference crash on destroyed elevator floors during saves fixed, improving overall stability.
- Mortar desynchronization resolved for reconnecting players and those entering network range, ensuring consistent combat.

### Map & Access
- Open fence gates added to the ranch and large barn, providing easier access to the vendor area.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Water sources can now be transferred between rooms via sinks without errors.
- Crabs now respect step height, avoid walls, and have corrected leg speeds; jellyfish water checks are optimized, improving swarm behavior.
- Floating animal glitches are resolved, and idle animal performance is smoother.
- Frogs no longer perform an excessively long first jump and will not get stuck in dead animations.

### Audio
- Biofuel generators are silent while idle, eliminating background noise.

items.text: Livestock vendor auction now pauses if the wool stack size changes mid‑offer; keep your inventory matching the original size or the sale will time out.
Livestock are now docile in safe zones, and the NPC livestock buyer correctly handles cases where livestock die or flee during conversation.
Animals no longer seek out food; food‑sensing disabled for animals that don’t need it, fixing odd food‑related behavior.
Cows can no longer graze on ice or sand, preventing them from wasting resources on unsuitable terrain.
Animal fence gate durability reduced from 500 HP to 100 HP, making them easier to break.
Country tag now respects streamer mode, hiding the player's country when the setting is enabled.
